sheets.prompt: Photorealistic beautiful realistic car-sale photography. Exact 3-column by 2-row contact sheet of 6 independent car-sale photographs. Equal panels touching edge to edge. No margins, borders, labels or collage decoration. Panels read left to right then second row. The complete vehicle must be visible in each panel, front three-quarter view, roof and wheels not cropped, 8 percent space around the car. Accurate specific model shape, headlights and trim. Clean appealing cars, tasteful factory styling. Summer in Blagoveshchensk, Amur region Russia: quiet broad streets, modern ordinary residential blocks, river-city greenery, clean private-sale parking. No people, no sales-service logos, no watermarks, no lettering, ALL registration plates completely blank with no digits or letters. Manufacturer badges allowed.
